hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */maps/rcn_map.html) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && python3 maps/build_standalone_map.py >/dev/null ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.json) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && { git check-ignore -q "$f" || { grep -q legendEntries "$f" 2>/dev/null && node tools/stamp-legend-style.js "$f" --write; }; } ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.statusMessage: Stamping legend style onto graph JSON
